hotels.title: Tropical Cairns Escape in the Heart of the City
hotels.description: In tropical Cairns, this polished retreat places you moments from the Esplanade Lagoon, the Cairns Aquarium and the marina for Great Barrier Reef departures. Contemporary rooms and suites offer a refined base in the city’s laidback north Queensland setting. Start the day with a swim in the outdoor pool before wandering to Rusty’s Markets for local produce and artisan treats. Nearby, savour just-caught seafood at Dundee’s on the Waterfront or explore the palm-fringed Cairns Botanic Gardens and rainforest boardwalks
